claims.text: _call validates args against the _INPUT ref_id and agent shapes, mapping SchemaError to bad_args with invalid_reference_arguments.
handle_reference_get and handle_reference_verify delegate to references.get and references.verify and rethrow ReferenceError codes as LineageError.
TOOLS declares the reference_get and reference_verify read-only specs with empty VALIDATORS and FOLDS maps.

decision.rule: Change here when reference tool arguments, delegation or read-only registration needs to change.
decision.failure: Invalid reference arguments reach domain reads or reference errors lose their codes.

questions.q: Where does _call validate reference tool arguments?
Where should I change the reference_get and reference_verify delegation?
Where can I debug why a reference tool returns invalid_reference_arguments?
